# Accessibility Agents

WCAG 2.2 AA enforcement for agentic coding clients: Claude Code, Codex, GitHub
Copilot, Gemini CLI and Antigravity. Six router skills dispatch a team of
accessibility specialists for web, document, markdown, desktop and GitHub
work; hooks refuse edits to user-facing files until the accessibility lead has
reviewed them; and an MCP server supplies the scanners.

This wiki mirrors the `docs/` folder of the
[repository](https://github.com/Community-Access/accessibility-agents), and is
rebuilt from it on every change. To correct a page, edit its source under
`docs/` and open a pull request.
